companyFieldUpdates.name: TotalEnergies North American Solar Portfolio (KKR co-investment)
aliases: TotalEnergies 1.4 GW North American solar portfolio
companyFieldUpdates.description: This descriptive portfolio grouping covers the two target holdcos in TotalEnergies' December 2025 sale of parallel 50% interests to KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts. The underlying North American portfolio comprises approximately 1.4 GW of operating utility-scale and distributed solar assets in the United States and Canada, including six utility-scale assets and 41 distributed-generation assets. TotalEnergies retained 50%, joint control and the operator role; KKR acquired the other 50%. The two holdcos, JVPTR acquisition vehicle and underlying project entities are embedded in this single record rather than counted as separate portfolio companies.

set.event: TotalEnergies agreed to sell 50% of an approximately 1.4 GW operating solar portfolio in the United States and Canada to KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts.
Merger-control and U.S. energy-regulatory approvals identified the two target holdcos and cleared 50/50 joint control.
The 50% sale closed, leaving TotalEnergies and KKR-managed vehicles as equal co-owners while TotalEnergies remained operator.
